mentions.name: Ordr
mentions.description: AI-powered task manager for people who feel overwhelmed. Users dump voice notes, text, images, and links, and Ordr calls an LLM to parse intent, extract tasks vs. events, assign order, and surface one clear next action — no tagging, sorting, or deciding required. Built with Flutter, Supabase, and Groq/Cerebras.
mentions.problem: Most productivity apps force users to do the organizing — projects, tags, priorities, fields — which is fine when calm but impossible when overwhelmed; people have tried every app and built their own systems yet still feel broken.
mentions.audience: People with too much to do and too much in their head who feel overwhelmed by manual organizing.
